newsitem.title: USA: Ky. Gov. supports LG&E, KU deal.
newsitem.headline: Ky. Gov. supports LG&E, KU deal.

text.p: Kentucky Gov. Paul Patton said on Wednesday that he supported a $1.54 billion merger between LG&E Energy Corp and KU Energy Corp.
LG&E and KU Energy are the respective parent companies of Louisville Gas and Electric Co and Kentucky Utilities.

"This appears to be a positive development," he said in a statement. "This means guaranteed lower rates for customers, a boost to economic development because of lower energy costs, and adds another Fortune 500 company to Kentucky"
"Additionally, the merger signifies that Kentucky people will continue to be served by a Kentucky company using Kentucky energy resources," Patton said.
